description:
As an advisor, I want to download a monthly PDF statement so that I can send it to my client.
Acceptance criteria:
- Given the portfolio page, when I choose a month and click "Download statement", then a PDF downloads
- The PDF shows the client name, the month and the holdings
- The PDF total equals the dashboard total for the last day of that month
- Given a month before the account opened, then the month cannot be chosen
- Given the statement is generating, then the button shows a loading state and cannot be clicked twice
traps: many criteria: the minimal-set rule (3-6 cases) is under pressure
